name: Days 1–30
focus: Choose one bounded task and measure a manual baseline
exit_evidence: Owner, source, baseline records, and accepted-output rule

name: Days 31–60
focus: Run an approved read-only supervised trial
exit_evidence: Paired time, accepted outputs, corrections, fallback, and stop logs

name: Days 61–90
focus: Review reliability, authority, full cost, and observed outcomes
exit_evidence: Human continue, change, or retire decision with cited evidence
